title: Structured Temporal Causality for Interpretable Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2510.16511v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world multivariate time series anomalies are rare and often unlabeled. Additionally, prevailing methods rely on increasingly complex architectures tuned to benchmarks, detecting only fragments of anomalous segments and overstating performance. In this paper, we introduce OracleAD, a simple and interpretable unsupervised framework for multivariate time series anomaly detection. OracleAD encodes each variable's past sequence into a single causal embedding to jointly predict the present time point and reconstruct the input window, effectively modeling temporal dynamics. These embeddings then undergo a self-attention mechanism to project them into a shared latent space and capture spatial relationships. These relationships are not static, since they are modeled by a property that emerges from each variable's temporal dynamics. The projected embeddings are aligned to a Stable Latent Structure (SLS) representing normal-state relations

translated_title: 用于可解释多元时间序列异常检测的结构化时间因果性
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的多元时间序列异常是罕见的，且通常缺乏标签。此外，主流方法依赖于针对基准数据集调优的日益复杂的架构，只能检测到异常片段的部分内容，并夸大了检测性能。在本文中，我们提出了OracleAD，一个简单且可解释的无监督多元时间序列异常检测框架。OracleAD将每个变量的过去序列编码为单一的因果嵌入，用于联合预测当前时间点并重建输入窗口，从而有效建模时间动态。随后，这些嵌入经过自注意力机制，被投影到共享潜在空间中以捕获变量间的空间关系。这些关系并非静态，而是通过从每个变量的时间动态中涌现的特性来建模的。投影后的嵌入与代表正常状态关系的稳定潜在结构对齐。
tldr: 提出了OracleAD，一个简单可解释的无监督多元时间序列异常检测框架，它将每个变量的时间动态编码为因果嵌入，通过自注意力机制建模动态空间关系，并与代表正常状态的稳定潜在结构对齐以检测异常。
en_tdlr: OracleAD is a simple and interpretable unsupervised framework for multivariate time series anomaly detection that encodes each variable's temporal dynamics into causal embeddings, captures dynamic spatial relationships via self-attention, and aligns them with a Stable Latent Structure representing normal-state relations.
